item.title: Hay’s Daze: Happy birthday, stuffies!
item.description: My Rotten Kid, the daughter one had more stuffies than the local Stuffies ‘R Us department store. In fact, her bedroom looked like it had been invaded and completely inhabited with little adorable plush puppies, kittens, and bunnies, and you had to look awfully hard to find the R.K. sleeping happily, buried in a fuzz-fest of creature cuteness.
